description: Send an existing draft as it stands: its subject, body, recipients and attachments go out unchanged. To change it first, use outlook_update_draft. Refuses a message that is not a draft, or a draft with no recipients. The confirmation shows exactly what will be sent and to whom. Once sent, Outlook files the copy in Sent Items under a new id. Outlook finishes a send in the background, so the result waits a few seconds for the draft to leave Drafts; if it has not, the result says to check Sent Items, never to resend. If Outlook does not answer in time, the connection drops, or a server error (5xx) comes back after the request was sent, the result has status "unknown": the write may well have gone through, so check before retrying — never resend blindly. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

id.description: Draft Id (from outlook_create_draft, outlook_reply draftOnly, or outlook_list_messages folder "drafts")

name: outlook_send_draft
